ownership_decision.invariant: Only Catalog validates retrieval inputs and controls public catalog scope.

boundary_decision.interaction: Existing synchronous model provider and public catalog API.
boundary_decision.consistency: synchronous read-only; no new durable state or cross-context write
prohibited_dependencies: Python must not own authorization, filter policy or fallback decisions.
Model output cannot select a workspace.

implementation_design.decision: No new Aggregate. Catalog owns bounded intent values and orchestration. Extend GET responses additively; add corrected-search POST on the same resource that bypasses model rewriting. Model keywords expand FTS candidates without acquiring full-coverage priority; the original task controls vector semantics, bigram coverage and exact-name ranking until the user explicitly corrects it.
invariants_preserved: Reference picker remains outside the intent funnel
rejected_alternatives: Separate search subsystem adds no invariant protection.
A shared failure flag silently hides vector loss.
Replacing the complete query embedding with extracted keywords regressed the fixed bilingual golden set.
Restoring original-query embeddings while giving shortened model keywords full-coverage priority recovered clean quality but increased poisoned Top-3 exposure.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Make rewriter always fail and remove the original-query vector attempt; the named nonempty-hit test must fail, then pass after restoration.

contract_change.description: Additive interpretation response, corrected-search POST and internal intent-analysis call.

open_questions: Normalized bigram text with pg_trgm reaches clean rewritten Chinese Top-1 of 28/30 and 24/30 while rejecting all six Chinese distractors at a measured 1/4 query-trigram coverage threshold, but fails the poisoning redline (24/25 poisoned Top-3 queries). It is not adopted: decide how to reconcile the existing curated-catalog boundary and ranking redline before changing production lexical retrieval.
The same normalized rule with original queries reaches 23/30 and 25/30 at that threshold; do not claim the rewrite-plus-embedding outage path meets the floor on both corpora.

Real projections give all 62 clean and 6 poisoned rows identical curated=false, verified_at-present, enriched and listable flags. Restricting to curated would remove the clean corpus too. The user authorized design and implementation of version-bound content review and exposure eligibility. The catalog-exposure-review package covers the durable policy; authorization does not approve Registry records or make failed poisoning measurements pass.

Service startup checks finite remaining key budget and the real Gateway rejects a synthetic spent-at-cap key. Unrecorded concurrent charges, cross-restart totals, direct Python startup and full deployed E2E remain unverified; do not turn these partial proofs into a complete cost guarantee.
